title: Getting Started with Arduino
subtitle: IDE, sketch structure, and uploading code

content.text: Every Arduino program (sketch) has two functions: setup() runs once at start; loop() runs continuously.

content.definition: An Arduino program. Equivalent to a C++ file with the .ino extension.

content.text: Avoid delay() in production sketches — it blocks everything. Use millis() for non-blocking timing instead.

questions.question: How many times does setup() run?
questions.explanation: setup() runs exactly once when the Arduino powers on or resets.

faq.q: Can I write Arduino code in C++?
faq.a: Yes. Arduino sketches are essentially C++ with a wrapper. You can use all C++ features and standard libraries.
